new_diseases.name: Psoriatic arthritis
new_diseases.mechanism: IL-23/IL-17/TNF enthesitis and synovitis with erosive and proliferative bone changes
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Dactylitis, enthesitis and psoriasis or nail dystrophy; RF negativity alone insufficient
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: NSAIDs/exercise, methotrexate for peripheral arthritis; targeted TNF/IL-17/IL-23 agents by phenotype; monitor infection and liver effects

new_diseases.name: Axial spondyloarthritis (including radiographic ankylosing spondylitis)
new_diseases.mechanism: TNF/IL-17 enthesitis and osteitis; progressive syndesmophyte formation in subset
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Inflammatory spinal pain plus objective imaging; HLA-B27 alone not diagnostic
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Exercise and NSAIDs first; targeted TNF/IL-17 agents with objective persistent activity; spinal fractures emergency

new_diseases.name: Calcium pyrophosphate deposition disease
new_diseases.mechanism: Calcium pyrophosphate deposition induces NLRP3/IL-1β innate inflammation
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Rhomboid weakly positive crystals; acute effusion still requires bacterial culture
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Aspiration and cultures, local corticosteroid, NSAID or colchicine by contraindications; renal/CYP interactions

new_diseases.name: Sjögren disease
new_diseases.mechanism: Lymphocytic exocrine epithelitis driven by interferon and B-cell activation
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Objective sicca and anti-SSA or lip salivary gland pathology; isolated anti-SSB insufficient
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Artificial tears/saliva and systemic-phenotype-specific therapies, monitor dental, lymphoma and neuropathy risks

new_diseases.name: Antiphospholipid syndrome
new_diseases.mechanism: Persistent anti-β2GP1/cardiolipin/lupus anticoagulant-associated thrombosis and obstetric morbidity
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Clinical thrombosis/pregnancy event plus persistent aPL tested ≥12 weeks apart
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Warfarin-based long-term therapy for thrombotic high-risk APS; pregnancy heparin plus aspirin; DOACs unsuitable in triple-positive high-risk disease

new_diseases.name: Dermatomyositis
new_diseases.mechanism: Complement microangiopathy and perifascicular myofiber injury; myositis-specific antibodies
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Gottron papules and perifascicular atrophy; anti-MDA5 may feature rapidly progressive ILD
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Glucocorticoids and steroid-sparing agents/IVIG in severe cases; anti-MDA5 ILD urgent aggressive care

new_diseases.name: Immune-mediated necrotizing myopathy
new_diseases.mechanism: Anti-HMGCR or anti-SRP autoimmune myofiber necrosis despite relatively sparse inflammation
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Necrosis with few lymphocytes; anti-HMGCR or anti-SRP; statin cessation alone often inadequate
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Glucocorticoids plus immunosuppression or IVIG with individualized anti-HMGCR/anti-SRP care

new_diseases.name: Sporadic inclusion body myositis
new_diseases.mechanism: Degenerative and inflammatory muscle injury with rimmed vacuoles; finger-flexor/quadriceps weakness
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Finger flexors/quadriceps and rimmed vacuoles; poor typical response to immunosuppression
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Rehabilitation, dysphagia and falls management; avoid reflex escalation of ineffective chronic immunosuppression

new_diseases.name: Adult-onset Still disease
new_diseases.mechanism: Systemic innate inflammation, prominent IL-1/IL-6 signaling and macrophage activation risk
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Quotidian high fevers, transient rash, neutrophilia and high ferritin after exclusion of infection/malignancy
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: IL-1 or IL-6 targeted therapy with corticosteroids as appropriate; macrophage activation syndrome emergency

new_diseases.name: Polymyalgia rheumatica
new_diseases.mechanism: Inflammatory periarticular synovial and bursal syndrome after age 50; consider coexistent GCA
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Proximal shoulder/hip stiffness with normal CK; assess giant-cell arteritis red flags
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Glucocorticoids carefully tapered, bone protection; new headaches/visual symptoms require GCA assessment

new_diseases.name: Takayasu arteritis
new_diseases.mechanism: Large-vessel inflammatory injury of aorta and major branches causing stenosis or aneurysm
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Absent pulses or limb BP discrepancy with aortic branch imaging; CRP can be normal
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Steroids plus steroid-sparing immunosuppression; monitor vessel stenosis/aneurysm by serial imaging

new_diseases.name: Polyarteritis nodosa
new_diseases.mechanism: Segmental transmural necrotizing inflammation of medium arteries; ANCA typically absent
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Medium-vessel aneurysms with mononeuritis multiplex; classic GN absent
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Severe PAN: glucocorticoid/cyclophosphamide; HBV-associated form requires antiviral-centered strategy

new_diseases.name: IgA vasculitis (Henoch–Schönlein purpura)
new_diseases.mechanism: Galactose-deficient IgA1 immune complexes in skin and renal mesangium
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Palpable purpura and GI/joint symptoms; continue renal and BP surveillance
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Supportive care, urine/proteinuria/BP follow-up; severe renal disease specialist immunosuppression

new_diseases.name: Behçet syndrome
new_diseases.mechanism: Neutrophilic inflammatory disease affecting variable-size vessels; ulcers, uveitis and thrombosis
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Recurrent oral/genital ulcers, eye/vascular involvement; HLA-B51 not diagnostic
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Colchicine for mucocutaneous disease, targeted drugs for severe eye/vascular/CNS disease; bleeding-risk pulmonary aneurysm

new_diseases.name: Relapsing polychondritis
new_diseases.mechanism: Immune cartilage destruction of auricular, nasal and tracheobronchial structures
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Painful auricular inflammation sparing lobule and risk of airway collapse
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Mild local disease NSAIDs; systemic steroids and DMARDs for severe; tracheobronchial collapse emergency

new_diseases.name: IgG4-related disease
new_diseases.mechanism: B-cell and CD4 cytotoxic T-cell driven fibroinflammation with storiform fibrosis/obliterative phlebitis
new_diseases.distinguishing_diagnostic_pattern: Storiform fibrosis/obliterative phlebitis in organ-appropriate tissue; elevated IgG4 alone insufficient
new_diseases.management_safety_summary: Steroids for induction; anti-CD19 inebilizumab FDA-approved in adults 2025; infection/HBV screening and organ monitoring
